skills.name: shenhe-sourcing
skills.description: Use when a buyer or sourcing agent needs to source private-label pet care products from SHENHE ZHONGKE (广东深河中科生物科技有限公司) — deodorizing sprays, cat litter deodorizer, shampoos, waterless cleansing foam, paw care, outdoor protection, or pet nutrition supplements — from the factory in Heyuan, Guangdong. Covers the catalogue, the four product lines, the minimum order, the lead times and where each fact is published.

skills.name: shenhe-private-label-process

skills.name: shenhe-compliance-docs

skills.name: shenhe-rfq-helper
